messages:
Aisha (CSM): FYI OceanGrid dropped active seats from ~70% to ~10% overnight. New ML lead joined and their notes mention a competitor pilot. Need renewal triage.
metrics-bot: alert account=oceangrid active_seats drop=60% window=3d severity=high
Jonah (AM): Is it cost, latency, or quality?
Aisha (CSM): Early signals: procurement flagged cost, and we see higher p50 latency in us-west. Also a couple of SDK error spikes.
Priya (Solutions): Can you paste the error snippet? If it's cache/KV related I can propose a quick config change.
Aisha (CSM): "ERROR: kvcache overflow at token 1024 -> fallback path" from their staging logs.
Nora (Sales): If it's a perf/cost pilot, we should offer a short Dedicated trial with price lock. I'll prep a one-pager for procurement.
Jonah (AM): Action plan: 1) Priya to validate config patch (12h) 2) Nora to draft procurement pitch + ROI 3) Aisha to message ML lead (cc @natalie_ocean) with a 1-line offer. Follow-up in 48h. I'll track.
Aisha (CSM): Reached out to Natalie: "Is the pilot focused on latency/cost? We can offer a 6-week Dedicated trial with reserved capacity and a joint tuning session." Waiting.
Priya (Solutions): I'll build a reproducible test and try a kvcache threshold adjustment. ETA 14h.
metrics-bot: note historical p50 latency=80ms current p50=220ms after drop
Aisha (CSM): Natalie replied: "Mostly cost + latency. Would consider a short Dedicated trial if it moves the needle."
Nora (Sales): Great. I'll confirm price-lock terms with pricing ops and prep slides for procurement.
Jonah (AM): Good work team. Keep updates here; if patch reduces errors we'll use that signal in the renewal playbook.
